panels.title: Review Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Shows HTTP-backed Bronze, Silver, and Gold record counts and outcomes. Zero is a recorded count. No matching rows are a valid empty result for the selected scope; backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Open Run Explorer for complete accounting. Counts and percentages are neutral accounting quantities, not quality verdicts. Exclusions alone have no severity threshold here; assess the DQ verdict and contract evidence. Percentages use the same precision (at least one decimal, up to three for small shares).
